title: Course Schedule
keyIdea: All courses can be finished exactly when the prerequisite graph has no cycle. Kahn: repeatedly take courses with indegree 0; if all n get taken there is no cycle. Or DFS with a "currently on the path" array.

approaches.name: DFS cycle detection
approaches.idea: DFS from each unvisited course; dfstrack marks the current path; reaching a course on the path = cycle.
approaches.why: Each course and edge is explored once.

approaches.name: Kahn's algorithm (BFS on indegrees)
approaches.idea: Queue indegree-0 courses; each taken course lowers its dependents' indegrees; count how many get taken.
approaches.why: Each course is queued once and each edge relaxed once.

quiz.q: [a, b] means b before a. Which way does the edge go?
Why does a cycle stop Kahn's algorithm from taking every course?
options: Every course on the cycle waits for another one on it, so none reaches indegree 0

quiz.q: In the DFS version, what is the difference between visited and dfstrack?
options: visited = seen ever; dfstrack = on the current path right now
